title: 호텔+미우 주문전용 — 요청/발주 매칭·잔량 업체 분류·주문 전후 검증

actions.name: SOURCE_ROW_COMPARISON_AND_BATCH_QUANTITY_GRID
actions.sideEffect: Compact image-aligned matching rows without repeated source column. Saved batches displayed as1..4 and later columns with canonical-unit totals. Cell edits use hotelConvert and preserve exact year/week and original evidence; allocations cleared. Hover/focus/click source comparison; frozen/storage failure block edits. No SQL or ERP changes.

actions.name: REVIEW_IMAGE_AND_SAVE_NUMBERED_QUANTITY
actions.sideEffect: Parsed rows first enter pending review, excluded from aggregate/order plan. Image original displayed beside editable matches; authenticated immutable owner-hashed PNG/JPEG/GIF/WEBP files live in data/runtime/hotel-order-images, max15MB. Explicit quantityN save commits source id + rows exactly once to server CAS draft, preserving year/week and image id. Legacy rows are quantity1. Pending review blocks order preparation. Frozen drafts protect pending/batches as well. No SQL/ERP changes.

actions.name: WORKSPACE_PERIOD_AND_TEXT_INPUT
actions.sideEffect: Hotel workspace defaults to existing sales business base major + subweek01; quick choices expose base-5 through base+5 with explicit rollover years and subweeks01..04. Legacy vendor tab keeps base..+9. Empty new period/default vendors do not autosave-lock the period. Text paste remains editable during background autosave or storage failure; latest text is queued by existing revision autosave, parse/registration remain blocked. Busy/frozen/not-ready input remains blocked. Saved scopes and old drafts are not silently reassigned. No SQL/API writer or downstream change.

actions.name: PARSE_IMAGE_OR_TEXT
actions.sideEffect: JSON text and TXT/TSV use parseHotelMiuText; XLS/XLSX/CSV use explicit single-sheet parseOrderImportSheetRows; multi-sheet returns sheet choices without matching. Images use Vision OCR. Temp files cleaned. Active Product, shared mappings, confirmed Raum/Shilla/Choimun/MIU(IAM)/Eunhwa hotel rows and board overlay are read. Conflicting hotel names require explicit board selection. No common mapping or Order/Shipment writes. Canonical Product factors returned for workspace unit normalization. Legacy text paste match rows retain the compact 입력/매칭/수량 table packed left (not stretched flex).

actions.name: SAVE_BOARD_PRODUCT_MAP
actions.sideEffect: INSERT WebHotelMiuProductMap overlay only. Also upserted when DRAFT/REGISTERED batch lines with ProdKey are saved. Does not write data/order-mappings.json. Paste-name tokens stay separate from prodbox:{ProdKey} box-factor rows.

actions.name: FAVORITE_CUSTOMER_WEEK
actions.sideEffect: Default chips 라움/신라/쵸이문/미우 resolved from Customer by name. Extra vendors stored in UserFavorite page=hotel-miu-board. Week input uses the sales business base major week (calendar major +1) through major +9, and exposes numeric subweeks 01/02/03/04. Direct inputs such as 36 + 2, 36-2, 36-1A, and 36-2B normalize to exact ERP OrderWeek 36-02, 36-02, 36-01, and 36-02 respectively; A/B is a logistics-flight suffix and never creates a separate ERP OrderWeek. Selected OrderYear+OrderWeek+CustKey go to later reads/writes. Ledger preserve.

actions.name: READ_BOX_FACTORS
actions.sideEffect: GET prodKeys reads Product FlowerName/CountryFlower and BunchOf1Box/SteamOf1Box/SteamOf1Bunch then overlays WebHotelMiuProductMap prodbox:{ProdKey} PerBox when present. Overlay wins and does not drop FlowerName. Does not UPDATE Product. No Order/Shipment write.

actions.name: SAVE_BOX_FACTOR_OVERLAY
actions.sideEffect: POST saveBoxFactor upserts WebHotelMiuProductMap InputToken=prodbox:{ProdKey} with PerBox. Confirm-table 박스당 blur and register persist this overlay like matching data. Does not UPDATE Product. No Order/Shipment/Estimate/WebProfitReport write.

actions.name: SAVE_DRAFT_BATCH
actions.sideEffect: INSERT WebHotelMiuIntakeBatch Status=DRAFT + lines for selected OrderYear+OrderWeek+CustKey. No Order/Shipment write. Displayed as 1합산/2합산.

actions.name: REGISTER_ORDER_ADD
actions.sideEffect: POST /api/orders source=hotel-miu-board isDelta add of merged DRAFT batches for selected OrderYear+OrderWeek+CustKey+ProdKey after a UI table confirm. Hidden OrderMaster/OrderDetail (isDeleted=1, qty 0) for the same year+week+cust+prod are revived instead of inserting a second row. Items that do not fill a box can be rounded up/down to whole boxes on that confirm table only; 합산 원문은 유지. 박스당 단/송이(perBox) can be edited on the confirm table (applyPerBoxOverride) and is saved as WebHotelMiuProductMap prodbox overlay, without writing Product. Round buttons show the resulting box qty. markRegistered also INSERTs WebHotelMiuRegisterSnap (before/after qty) for the week popup. ShipmentMaster is not ensured (not raum-pnl). Cross-year same OrderWeek is excluded.

actions.name: READ_REGISTER_HISTORY
actions.sideEffect: After a vendor is selected, clicking a week chip GETs WebHotelMiuRegisterSnap + REGISTERED 합산 + ViewOrder 전산 현재 for that OrderYear+OrderWeek+CustKey and opens a popup of 1차/2차/3차 vs 반올림 전 vs 반올림 후 vs 전산 현재. The same table is always shown on the 주문반영 내역 panel, grouped under Product.FlowerName (else CountryFlower, else ProdName prefix) with selectable 전체/수국/장미 buttons. Empty selection shows all groups. Filter is localStorage display-only and does not change which items REGISTER_ORDER_ADD writes. Stem/bunch qty is labeled as 2065송이 (68박스 + 25송이) using Product/overlay perBox. Each 주문반영 line shows 전/후. GET year/week calls ensureTables so snaps are not dropped. No Order/Shipment write. Cross-year same OrderWeek is excluded.

actions.name: REVISE_BATCH_INCREASE
actions.sideEffect: batchQtyDelta positive qty is sent to createOrder as signed add. WebHotelMiuIntakeLine replaced for that BatchKey scoped by OrderYear+OrderWeek+CustKey. Shipment preserve.

actions.name: REVISE_BATCH_DECREASE
actions.sideEffect: REGISTERED 합산 삭제/품목 제거 sends the rounded snap afterQty as signed subtract (what createOrder actually added), not the 합산 원문. If the same ProdKey remains on another REGISTERED 합산, 원문 batchQtyDelta is used. 합산 수정 품목 재매칭도 이전 ProdKey를 이 delta로 뺀다. If cancel exceeds remaining OrderDetail.OutQuantity, hotel-miu-board clamps to 0 and hides the row. Empty updateBatch still soft-deletes the web batch (isDeleted=1) scoped by OrderYear+OrderWeek+CustKey. Does not write Shipment*/Estimate/WebProfitReport. Card 삭제/× honor busy so this cannot overlap REGISTER_ORDER_ADD stock calc.

actions.name: REMATCH_BATCH_LINE
actions.sideEffect: 합산 수정 modal 품목 매칭 updates that line then persistBatchLines. DRAFT writes WebHotelMiuIntakeLine + WebHotelMiuProductMap overlay only. REGISTERED sends signed delta (old ProdKey negative, new ProdKey positive) via createOrder hotel-miu-board for selected OrderYear+OrderWeek+CustKey+ProdKey. Old key uses snap afterQty when it leaves the last REGISTERED 합산. Does not write Shipment*/Estimate/WebProfitReport. Cross-year same OrderWeek is excluded.

actions.name: BLOCK_OVERLAPPING_WRITE
actions.sideEffect: writeLock + disabled={!!busy} block 합산 삭제/×/주문등록/다시 더하기 while a prior POST /api/orders is in flight. Prevents overlapping negative delta from wiping the just-added OrderDetail. No extra Order/Shipment write.

actions.name: REAPPLY_REGISTER_SNAP
actions.sideEffect: Week popup 등록내역을 전산에 다시 더하기 posts snap afterQty as signed add for selected OrderYear+OrderWeek+CustKey+ProdKey. Revives hidden OrderDetail instead of a second row. Does not write Shipment*/Estimate/WebProfitReport. Cross-year same OrderWeek is excluded.

actions.name: HOTEL_ORDER_WORKSPACE
actions.sideEffect: Default hotel order workspace: request minus purchase; purchase to Raum, whole residual boxes to hotel surplus, remainder explicitly assigned. Uses existing my-customer ADD with expectedCurrentQty, preserving stock/shipment/estimate/profit. Client persists pending receipt before each POST; unknown outcomes block retry. Server results previousQty/finalQty are the audit values. Parse reads existing shared and hotel mappings only; ambiguous matches require selection.

actions.name: SAVE_SERVER_WORKSPACE
actions.sideEffect: Authenticated userId + OrderYear + OrderWeek + UUID scoped immutable server runtime revision files. Autosave includes raw text, matched rows, allocation and before/after results. Atomic exclusive publication rejects stale/concurrent revision with 409. Frozen intent and each pending receipt saved before existing orders POST; no blind retry or completed receipt removal. Same-account other PCs list and resume by year/week. Legacy browser import uses deterministic identity and never replaces newer server work. No SQL/schema/ERP ledger writes.

crossYearFixture.description: 2025와 2026의 동일 차수(예: 39-02)라도 화면 연도+정규화 차수+CustKey만 조회·가산한다. 2026년 말 +9 범위가 2027년으로 넘어가도 각 선택값의 명시 연도를 전달하며 전년도 Master를 재사용하지 않는다.
